verses.en: And it came to pass on the day that Moses had fully set up the tabernacle, and had anointed it, and sanctified it, and all the instruments thereof, both the altar and all the vessels thereof, and had anointed them, and sanctified them;
verses.sm: Ua oo i le aso na uma ai ona faatuina e Mose o le malumalu, ma na faauuina, ma faapaiaina ai, ma mea uma o i ai, o le fata faitaulaga foi ma ana mea uma na ia faauuina ai, ma faapaiaina;

verses.en: That the princes of Israel, heads of the house of their fathers, who were the princes of the tribes, and were over them that were numbered, offered:
verses.sm: ona fai taulaga ai lea o alii sili o Isaraelu, o matai o aiga o latou tamā, o alii sili i latou i itu aiga, o e na pule i e na faitaulia,

verses.en: And they brought their offering before the LORD, six covered wagons, and twelve oxen; a wagon for two of the princes, and for each one an ox: and they brought them before the tabernacle.
verses.sm: ua latou au mai a latou taulaga i luma o Ieova, o fata faataavalevale ua ufitia e ono, ma povi e sefulu ma le lua; o alii e taitoalua ma le fata faataavalevale e tasi, ma a latou povi e taitasi; ua latou au mai ai i luma o le malumalu.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.sm: Ona fetalai mai ai lea o Ieova ia Mose, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Take it of them, that they may be to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; and thou shalt give them unto the Levites, to every man according to his service.
verses.sm: Ia e talia ia mea mai ia te i latou, ina ia fai a‘i le galuega o le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga; e te tuuina atu ai i sa Levī, o le tagata ma le mea e tatau i lana galuega.

verses.en: And Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them unto the Levites.
verses.sm: Ona talia lea e Mose o fata faataavalevale ma povi, ma tuu atu ai i sa Levī.

verses.en: Two wagons and four oxen he gave unto the sons of Gershon, according to their service:
verses.sm: O fata faataavalevale e lua ma povi e fa na ia tuuina atu ai i le fanauga a Keresoma, e faatatau i la latou galuega.

verses.en: And four wagons and eight oxen he gave unto the sons of Merari, according unto their service, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.sm: O fata faataavalevale e fa ma povi e valu na ia tuuina atu ai i le fanauga a Merari, e faatatau i la latou galuega, i le pule a Itamaro le atalii o Arona le ositaulaga.

verses.en: But unto the sons of Kohath he gave none: because the service of the sanctuary belonging unto them was that they should bear upon their shoulders.
verses.sm: A o le fanauga a Koato na ia le tuuina atu i ai se mea; auā o le galuega o le malumalu na ia te i latou, latou te tauave ai i o latou ua.

verses.en: And the princes offered for dedicating of the altar in the day that it was anointed, even the princes offered their offering before the altar.
verses.sm: Ua fai taulaga foi alii sili i le faasaina o le fata faitaulaga i le aso na faauuina ai, ua avatu ai e alii sili a latou taulaga i luma o le fata faitaulaga.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedicating of the altar.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai mai ai lea o Ieova ia Mose, E taitasi le alii sili ma lona aso latou te au mai ai a latou taulaga i le faasaina o le fata faitaulaga.

verses.en: And he that offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah:
verses.sm: O le na au mai lana taulaga i le uluai aso, o Naasona lea o le atalii o Aminatapu, o le itu aiga o Iuta ia;

verses.en: And his offering was one silver charger, the weight thereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them were full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
verses.sm: o lana taulaga foi o le tanoa ario e tasi, o lona mamafa e tasi le selau ma le tolugafulu o sekeli; o le ipu ario e tasi, e fitugafulu o sekeli lona mamafa o le sekeli lea o le malumalu; ua tutumu ia mea o lua i le falaoa lelei ua palua ma le uu e fai ma taulaga i mea e ‘ai;

verses.en: One spoon of ten shekels of gold, full of incense:
verses.sm: o le ipu auro e tasi, e sefulu o sekeli lona mamafa, ua tumu i mea manogi e mu;

verses.en: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
verses.sm: o le povi poa taanoa e tasi, o le mamoe poa e tasi, ma le tamai mamoe e tasi ua tasi lona tausaga, e fai ma taulaga mu;

verses.en: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
verses.sm: o le ‘oti poa e tasi, e fai ma taulaga mo le agasala;

verses.en: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
verses.sm: o povi foi e lua, o mamoe poa e lima, o ‘oti poa e lima, ma tamai mamoe e lima e tasi lo latou tausaga, e fai ma taulaga faafetai; o le taulaga lea a Naasona le atalii o Aminatapu.

verses.sm: o le povi poa taanoa e tasi, o le mamoe poa e tasi, ma le tamai mamoe e tasi ua tasi lona tausaga, e fai ma taulaga mu;

verses.en: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
verses.sm: o le ‘oti poa e tasi, e fai ma taulaga mo le agasala;

verses.en: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.sm: o povi foi e lua, o mamoe poa e lima, o ‘oti poa e lima, ma tamai mamoe e lima e tasi lo latou tausaga, e fai ma taulaga faafetai; o le taulaga lea a Akira o le atalii o Enano.

verses.en: This was the dedication of the altar, in the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve chargers of silver, twelve silver bowls, twelve spoons of gold:
verses.sm: O le faasaina lenei o le fata faitaulaga e alii sili o Isaraelu i le aso na faauuina ai; o tanoa ario e sefulu ma le lua, o ipu ario e sefulu ma le lua, o ipu auro e sefulu ma le lua;

verses.en: Each charger of silver weighing an hundred and thirty shekels, each bowl seventy: all the silver vessels weighed two thousand and four hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
verses.sm: o tanoa ario e taitasi ma sekeli e tasi le selau ma le tolugafulu lona mamafa, o ipu e taitasi ma sekeli e fitugafulu lona mamafa; o mea ario uma e lua afe ma le fa galau o sekeli ia, o le sekeli lea o le malumalu;

verses.en: The golden spoons were twelve, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, after the shekel of the sanctuary: all the gold of the spoons was an hundred and twenty shekels.
verses.sm: o ipu auro e sefulu ma le lua sa tutumu i mea manogi e mu, e taisefulu sekeli lo latou mamafa, o le sekeli lea o le malumalu; o auro uma o ipu e tasi le selau ma le luafulu o sekeli.

verses.en: All the oxen for the burnt offering were twelve bullocks, the rams twelve, the lambs of the first year twelve, with their meat offering: and the kids of the goats for sin offering twelve.
verses.sm: O povi uma e fai ma taulaga mu, o povi poa e sefulu ma le lua, o mamoe poa e sefulu ma le lua, ma tamai mamoe e tasi lo latou tausaga e tasi le sefulu ma le lua, ma o latou taulaga i mea e ‘ai; o ‘oti poa foi e sefulu ma le lua e fai ma taulaga mo le agasala.

verses.en: And all the oxen for the sacrifice of the peace offerings were twenty and four bullocks, the rams sixty, the he goats sixty, the lambs of the first year sixty. This was the dedication of the altar, after that it was anointed.
verses.sm: O povi uma foi e fai ma taulaga faafetai e luafulu ma le fa o povi poa ia, o mamoe poa e onogafulu, o ‘oti poa e onogafulu, ma tamai mamoe e tasi lo latou tausaga e onogafulu. O le faasaina lea o le fata faitaulaga ina ua uma ona faauuina ai.

verses.en: And when Moses was gone into the tabernacle of the congregation to speak with him, then he heard the voice of one speaking unto him from off the mercy seat that was upon the ark of testimony, from between the two cherubims: and he spake unto him.
verses.sm: Ua ulu atu Mose i le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga la te taulaga ma Ieova, ona lagona ai lea e ia o le siufofoga ua tūlei mai ia te ia ai le nofoa o le alofa ua i luga o le atolaau o le tulafono, mai le va o kerupi e lua; ua fetalai mai lava o ia ia te ia.
